notes: Update staging: the staging feed and the Setup URL are canonicalized from their own parse, the unsigned staging fetch is plain HTTP without redirects and without an environment proxy, and one in-flight guard keeps a startup check and a manual check from staging two Setups at once. Diagnostics: the newest job timelines are selected by full-resolution modification time. Release integrity: every checksum row is validated against the bytes it names, the published list is rebuilt from the published assets, the feed signature ships beside the main-branch copy, and the update manifest identity is cross-checked against the extension key, version and CRX digest. This release is not full-product acceptance.
